You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 42c1a6f62e5c46269ed37238f6a5331b30c32c75 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marek Vasut <marex@denx.de>
Date: Tue, 26 Apr 2022 22:03:29 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] arm64: dts: imx8mm: Use 100 kHz I2C2 on Data Modul i.MX8M
 Mini eDM SBC

The I2C2 has SMBus device SMSC USB2514Bi connected to it, the device is
capable of up to 100 kHz operation. Reduce the bus frequency to 100 kHz
to guarantee this I2C device can work correctly.

Fixes: 583f24ae42a07 ("arm64: dts: imx8mm: Add support for Data Modul i.MX8M Mini eDM SBC")
Signed-off-by: Marek Vasut <marex@denx.de>
Cc: Fabio Estevam <festevam@denx.de>
Cc: Peng Fan <peng.fan@nxp.com>
Cc: Shawn Guo <shawnguo@kernel.org>
Cc: NXP Linux Team <linux-imx@nxp.com>
To: linux-arm-kernel@lists.infradead.org
Signed-off-by: Shawn Guo <shawnguo@kernel.org>
---
 arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mm-data-modul-edm-sbc.dts | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mm-data-modul-edm-sbc.dts b/arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mm-data-modul-edm-sbc.dts
index b2d90b79f500..8c9dd09dbc74 100644
--- a/arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mm-data-modul-edm-sbc.dts
+++ b/arch/arm64/boot/dts/freescale/imx8mm-data-modul-edm-sbc.dts
@@ -392,7 +392,7 @@ ldo6_reg: LDO6 {
 
 &i2c2 {
 	/* IMX8MM ERRATA e7805 -- I2C is limited to 384 kHz due to SoC bug */
-	clock-frequency = <320000>;
+	clock-frequency = <100000>;
 	pinctrl-names = "default", "gpio";
 	pinctrl-0 = <&pinctrl_i2c2>;
 	pinctrl-1 = <&pinctrl_i2c2_gpio>;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The I2C2 bus was originally set to operate at a frequency of 320 kHz, which is higher than the maximum operational capability of the connected SMBus device, SMSC USB2514Bi, which can only handle up to 100 kHz. This mismatch in frequency caused the device to malfunction. The patch reduces the I2C2 bus frequency to 100 kHz to ensure compatibility and proper functioning of the device.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The I2C2 bus was originally set to operate at a frequency of 320 kHz, which is higher than the maximum operational capability of the connected SMBus device, SMSC USB2514Bi, which can only handle up to 100 kHz. This mismatch in frequency caused the device to malfunction. The patch reduces the I2C2 bus frequency to 100 kHz to ensure compatibility and proper functioning of the device.
